test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who does not believe that God or Gods exist.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Atheist.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• "Irreverent" means showing a lack of respect for something or someone that is usually considered sacred or holy.

 
 
• Example: She has an irreverent attitude towards marriage.
 
 
 
• **An atheist is a person who does not believe in the existence of God or gods**.
 
 
• ​Example: He said he is an atheist when asked about his views on God.
 
 
 
• "Profane" means disrespectful or vulgar language or behaviour.
 
 
• ​Example: They have profaned the long upheld traditions of the temple.
 
 
 
• "Blasphemous" means the act of insulting or showing contempt or lack of reverence for God or something considered sacred.
 
 
• ​Example: What he says is blasphemous and upsets believers.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, **it is clear that the word "atheist" can substitute the given phrase.**

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
